Studydown

Privacy Policy

The Studydown app does not collect personal data. Focus records are processed and stored on your device.

Last updated: 2026-09-05

Data kept on your device

Activity names, focus sessions, summaries, weekly goals, Deadlines and settings stay in local app storage. Studydown has no account or developer server.

Motion information

Studydown reads orientation and movement only as needed to recognise that the iPhone is face down. Raw sensor readings are not retained, sent or linked to you.

Purchases through Apple

StoreKit communicates with Apple when you buy or restore Lifetime Pro. Apple handles the transaction; Studydown never receives your payment details.

Files you create

CSV and JSON files are made only when you request them. You choose where to save or share them, after which the destination's own privacy terms apply.

Contacting support

If you email us, we receive the address and message you decide to send. They are used only to answer you and are never sold or used for advertising.

This website

This static website sets no cookies and loads no analytics, adverts, trackers or third-party scripts. GitHub Pages hosts the files and may process standard connection information under its own privacy terms.

Also on Android

The Android app stores Activities, sessions, and settings in local app storage only, with no account or developer server. Purchases and restoration are handled through Play Store billing; Studydown does not receive your payment details.

Local notifications

Reminder settings and notification text stay on the device. iOS schedules local notifications; Studydown does not use a remote push server or upload a device token. Notification permission is requested when you enable reminders or use the permission control, not on first launch.

Apple services and motion processing

StoreKit may contact Apple to load products and localised prices and to verify, buy or restore Lifetime Pro. The app reads verified transaction and entitlement information, not payment details, and sends no focus records for purchases. Apple's services follow Apple's terms. CoreMotion processes orientation and movement locally, not camera images; motion tracking stops when the app becomes inactive.

Your devices, storage and deletion

Widgets use local App Group storage. Live Activities have no server push. Apple Watch uses WatchConnectivity to exchange Activity names and identifiers, session times, summaries, preferences and entitlement state with the paired iPhone, not a developer server. Saved records remain until erased or replaced. Settings → Your data → Erase all data deletes local records after confirmation. Exported files, Watch copies and any Apple-managed device backups are separate; erasing app data does not guarantee erasing those copies. Device backups depend on your system settings.

Contact

Explain what happened and include your device and iOS version. Please do not include private focus records.

Email support hourstag.app@gmail.com
